props.text:
Diaphragm pump driven by a motor,
uses flexible membranes to displace
fluid without contact.

Electrically-operated valve that
opens when energized to allow water
flow to the fill station.

Holds the water supply for the
bottle filling process.

Detects whether a 16.9 oz bottle
is present and positioned correctly
at the fill station.

Measures the flow rate of water
passing through the pipe toward
the fill station.
